WISH_OTHER_PULLS_NOTE: Deduct wishes for pulls outside your target list.
WISH_USE_STARTING: Allow other planned pulls in this patch to use starting wishes when they exceed the patch's income.
WISH_RADIANCE_INTRO: Track these points from your featured-character 50/50 history.
WISH_RADIANCE_INDEPENDENT: Independent of the featured-character guarantee. Both can be active at the same time.
WISH_COST_ASSUMPTION_NOTE: These values model pulls per 5-star. Current pity reduces the first modeled cost.
WISH_REFUND_ESTIMATE_NOTE: Estimated share of spent wishes recovered through Starglitter.
WISH_GUARANTEE_ON: Your next character 5-star is guaranteed to be featured.
WISH_AVERAGE_MODE_NOTE: Same base income each patch; selected bonuses are added separately.
WISH_CUSTOM_MODE_NOTE: Enter the total income for each patch. Include Welkin Moon and Battle Pass wishes in these totals yourself; nothing is added automatically.
WISH_STOCKPILE_EFFECT: {patch} income: {income} wishes. Other pulls: {spend}. Uses {used} starting wishes.
WISH_STOCKPILE_DISABLED: Current patch only. Other pulls are limited to this patch's income.
WISH_BANNER_HELP: Current pity applies to your first attempt on each banner type. The featured-character guarantee applies to your next character 5-star. Radiance Points track your character 50/50 loss history separately from that guarantee.
WISH_INCOME_BASE_NOTE: Average income adds selected Welkin and Battle Pass bonuses. Custom values are the full income for each patch.
WISH_ORDER_HELP: Evaluated from top to bottom. Use the arrows to change the order.
WISH_REQUIRED_HELP: Plan to obtain this target, including after a miss. Report a shortfall if wishes are insufficient.
WISH_ONCE_HELP: Stop at the first 5-star, even if it is not your target. Skip if the attempt is unaffordable.
WISH_OPTIONAL_CHAR_HELP: Can be skipped to protect Must-have targets. Stop at the first 5-star, even if it misses the target.
WISH_OPTIONAL_WEAPON_HELP: Can be skipped to protect Must-have targets. Budget for the follow-up after a miss.
WISH_RESERVED_SKIP: Optional target skipped to protect Must-have targets.
WISH_UNAFFORDABLE_SKIP: Skipped: not enough wishes for this attempt.
WISH_ALL_TARGETS_NOTE: Includes One Shot and Optional targets.
WISH_BUDGET_CHANCE: Chance to avoid a budget shortfall
WISH_BUDGET_NOTE: Flexible targets may still be missed or skipped.
WISH_EXACT_NOTE: All outcome patterns evaluated within your assumptions.
WISH_ESTIMATE_NOTE: Estimated from sampled outcomes within your assumptions.
WISH_BALANCE_STATS_NOTE: Balances are in wishes. Best and worst balances refer to the returned scenarios; averages are conditional on budget success or failure.
WISH_STOCKPILE_ON: Outside spending can use the starting stockpile in the first patch.
WISH_STOCKPILE_OFF: Outside spending does not use the starting stockpile.
WISH_MEDIAN_NOTE: A representative outcome at the middle of the wishes-remaining distribution. This is one scenario, not a guarantee.
WISH_SEARCH_NOTE: The worst feasible outcome found by a bounded search. It is not a proven absolute limit.
WISH_EXPECTED_NOTE: The model's probability-favored win or loss pattern. This is a deterministic reference, not an expected-value promise.
WISH_PERCENTILE_NOTE: Percentiles rank outcomes by wishes remaining. P90 is not a 90% chance of getting a target.
WISH_FIX_INPUTS: Check the highlighted setup value before calculating.
WISH_PREVIOUS_NOTE: These results belong to your previous inputs.
WISH_EMPTY_HELP: Add a character or weapon, choose the goal, then arrange your targets in pull order.
WISH_ONE_SHOT_LIMIT: One Shot is available only when acquiring one copy.
WISH_GOAL_REQUIRED: Choose a goal above what you currently own.
WISH_MISSING_PATCH: Enter a start patch to calculate.
WISH_NO_TARGETS: Add at least one enabled target to calculate.
WISH_TARGET_ORDER_INVALID: {later} is on a later banner than {earlier}, but appears above it. Reorder targets chronologically before calculating.
WISH_TARGET_ORDER_TITLE: Targets are out of chronological order

TIMED_OUT_SERVER: Timed out waiting for the server.
RADIANCE_CAPTURE_TITLE: Capture Radiance: guaranteed win after 3 consecutive losses
RADIANCE_EARLY_TITLE: Early Radiance: guaranteed win after 2 consecutive losses

FATE_POINT_GAINED_NEXT_PULL: Missed the featured weapon, gained a Fate Point: obtained via Epitomized Path on the next 5★ weapon pull
FATE_POINT_GAINED_NEXT_PULL_CHOSEN: Missed the featured weapon, gained a Fate Point: the next 5★ weapon is guaranteed to be your chosen one via Epitomized Path
ONE_SHOT_NOT_CHASED_TITLE: Missed the featured weapon: One Shot doesn't chase the Epitomized Path, so the copy was not obtained and the attempt ended there
NOT_OBTAINED_ONE_SHOT: Not obtained: One Shot, not chased
LOST_5050_WON_GUARANTEE: Lost the 50/50 this patch, then won on the guaranteed pull
LOST_5050_WON_NEXT_GUARANTEE: Lost the featured 50/50, then obtained it on the guaranteed next pull
LOST_5050_NOT_CHASED: Lost the featured 50/50: this strategy doesn't chase the guarantee, so the copy was not obtained and the guarantee carries forward to the next character patch
ENTERED_GUARANTEED_PLAIN: Entered the patch already guaranteed: no roll this patch

WISH_RATE_LIMIT_MOMENT: Whoa, slow down - try again in a moment.

CALENDAR_LOAD_FAILED_EVENTS: Couldn't load events right now - the calendar source might be down. Try again in a bit.
CALENDAR_LOAD_FAILED_BANNERS: Couldn't load banners right now - the calendar source might be down. Try again in a bit.
ROLLED_LOST: Rolled: would've needed {n} wishes - you only had {budget}

FORECAST_TIMEOUT_ERROR: The forecast engine took too long to respond. Try again?

PLANNED_SPEND_STOCKPILE_NAME: Also deduct from Wishes on Hand & Primogems
PLANNED_SPEND_STOCKPILE_SUB: Only applies to the current patch ({v})
NEED_MORE_COPIES: Need {n} more cop{s} to go from {prefix}{cur} to {prefix}{goal}.
ENTER_START_PATCH_PROMPT: Enter your start patch above to see scenarios.
TOOLTIP_BUDGET: Chance that your plan finishes without running out of wishes. Optional targets may be dropped to protect this.{estimated}
TOOLTIP_PERFECT: Chance that every target in your plan is obtained, including One Shot and Optional targets.{estimated}
TOOLTIP_DEFICIT_SHARE: Share of scenarios that ended with a Hard Lock target short (couldn’t be afforded).{estimated}
TOOLTIP_AVG_SURPLUS: Average leftover wishes across every outcome where the Hard Lock budget was met, weighted by probability.{estimated}
TOOLTIP_SKIPS: Chance that at least one One Shot or Optional target gets skipped: unaffordable on its own, or dropped to protect a Hard Lock target.{estimated}
TOOLTIP_AVG_DEFICIT: Average shortfall across every outcome where a Hard Lock target couldn’t be afforded, weighted by probability.{estimated}
MOBILE_TABLE_HINT: 📱 This table reads best on a tablet or desktop. On phones, use {viewFullTable} or {saveAsImage} below.
WISH_LEGEND_BUDGET_NOTE: Budget means no modeled shortfall; misses or skips may remain. Perfect means every requested copy, including Optional targets.
WISH_LEGEND_CHANCE_NOTE: Shortfall chances use available wishes only and ignore current pity, guarantee, and Radiance. Missing lookup data is shown as Chance unavailable.
WISH_LEGEND_RESULT_NOTE: Scenario results report final balance or the last shortfall. Negative values are not a sum and are not necessarily the largest shortfall. Best Outcome and Worst Outcome use the named Baseline Best and Worst scenarios; True Worst remains a separate scenario.
LEGEND_RAN_OUT: Ran out of wishes: % is the odds of still guaranteeing with what's left.

STORAGE_LOAD_BLOCKED: ⚠️ This browser/tab is blocking saved data, so nothing will persist between visits. Check Brave Shields (cookie/site-data blocking) or "Clear on exit" settings for this site. You can still use Export/Import below to save and reload your plan manually.
IMPORT_INVALID_FILE: ⚠️ That file could not be read as a valid plan export.
GUARANTEE_SCOPE_NOTE: Only applies to your very first character target.
RADIANCE_EXPLANATION: How many featured 5★ 50/50s you've lost in a row right now. A 50/50 win brings this down by 1 (not straight to 0); Radiance brings it down to 1 (not 0); using a guarantee in between does not change it. This is independent from "{guaranteedNext}" - any combination of the two is possible, since a loss at any Radiance count also puts you into an ordinary pity guarantee. You can verify your wish history on paimon.moe/wish.
SPEND_OUTSIDE_PLAN_NAME: Planning to spend wishes outside this plan
SPEND_OUTSIDE_PLAN_SUB: Regular banner pulls, events you're skipping, etc.
SPEND_OUTSIDE_PLAN_EXPLANATION: Requires a start patch. Enter how many wishes per patch you expect to spend on things outside your priority pipeline, and it'll be subtracted from your projected income.
WIN_COSTS_EXPLANATION: Assumed pulls to win the 5★ (not a guarantee).
BANNER_PITY_EXPLANATION: Your current pity count for each banner.
PROJECTED_WISHES_DESC: Total wishes across your whole planning window.
REORDER_HINT: Use ▲▼ to reorder. Assessed top-to-bottom chronologically.
PATCHES_FROM_NOW_EXPLANATION: Patches from now (max 8). Raises "Total Patches to Plan Ahead" to match once you hit Save.
APPLY_PACING_SUB: Uncheck if you're topping up on demand instead of waiting on drip income
WISH_DETAIL_SUCCESS_SUMMARY: No modeled budget shortfall at the final checkpoint: {n} wishes left.
WISH_DETAIL_SHORTFALL_SUMMARY: Budget shortfall at the last checkpoint: {n} wishes short.
WISH_MODELED_RECOVERY_ESTIMATE: Modeled recovery estimate: ~{n} wishes via Starglitter
